about: Sunshot's own document templates (S12): style + canvas + frame or device + placement, never content. Omitted keys take the new-document defaults. canvas: {ratio} or {width, height} (omitted = Auto); backdrop: exactly one of solid (hex), gradient (gradient-presets id), wallpaper (wallpapers id) or none: true; corners: {style, radius}; shadow: {style, intensity}; frame: a frame kind; device: {model, finish, landscape, arrangement} from devices.json; layout: a layout-presets id. The first template must be the plain new document.
